name: Subject–verb agreement

stages.needs: an essay evaluator validated for this competency
stages.note: The LLM evaluator has not been run or measured. The pattern stand-in (openpath-patterns) has a few fixed rules for it (recall 0.11 overall on the synthetic benchmark): a demonstration tool, not an assessment. Validation material: the essay benchmark (essay-validation-v1).

stages.needs: 3 unseen questions near the target (at least 2 answered without help)
stages.note: Diagnosis-pool questions; at least one right answer near the target is needed to rule a gap out.

stages.needs: at least one lesson
stages.note: Candidate lessons (content/english/web/lessons.json), not yet educator-reviewed.

stages.needs: 3 practice questions (below the target, or practice-pool)
stages.note: Answers with help are held: practice is never evidence.

stages.needs: 2 unseen questions between band 5 and 6.5, in a new sitting
stages.note: The journey's check.

stages.needs: up to 3 later checks of 2 (6 questions), spaced 1, 3, 7 days
stages.note: Needed only while the target is not shown; the full allowance is counted.

stages.needs: 2 questions kept back, asked at least 7 days after the target is first shown
stages.note: Judged by the engine's own retention rule.

stages.stage: 8. Transfer into a later writing task
stages.needs: a later essay (and the 50-word rewrite) observed by a validated evaluator
stages.note: The second essay's observations are tentative and the rewrite is transfer evidence only; both depend on the unvalidated evaluator. The rewrite judge (LLM) is unmeasured.
